requirements: Confirm the remote source head and check that round-eight has not been claimed or that any worker/executor has stopped with evidence. Do not execute concurrently. Capture exact commands, source heads, exit codes, fresh logs and test XML.

Run ./gradlew :solr:core:test --tests org.apache.solr.cloud.SolrZkServerTlsTest -Dtests.seed=5329ABCD and both org.apache.solr.handler.admin.ZookeeperStatusHandlerTest and org.apache.solr.handler.admin.ZookeeperStatusHandlerFailureTest; report counts and skips.

Run ./gradlew :solr:packaging:integrationTests --tests test_secure_example.bats as an unprivileged user. Require all nine cases to execute without skips; retain XML and logs. Confirm the trusted certificate fixture reaches the secure CLI and plaintext listener assertions; separately report confirmation, password creation and permission cases.

Demonstrate the partial zoo.cfg write interceptor fails at the intended write, preserves the original file byte-for-byte, and the retry creates complete configuration. Demonstrate failed include replacement preserves the include and a later retry reaches a successful TLS listener. Mutate or revert the staged-write protection separately for each path and show the relevant assertion fails, not merely a setup failure.

Exercise denied zoo.cfg and include writes, existing operator-managed secureClientPort configuration, missing config, file mode and ownership preservation, symbolic links and a destination directory that is not writable. Record actual behavior, cleanup and compatibility limitations. Confirm failed staging never leaves a misleading success message or a partially written destination.

Run ./gradlew tidy and confirm no tracked formatting changes; run ./gradlew check -x test, record exact exclusions and failures including documentation-site and Docker limitations. Changes to formatting require a new pushed head and gate.

Compare current tests and production code to prior receipt fail-before confirmation, ensemble and unification and password umask mutation legs; rerun any leg whose relevant code or setup changed. Never count a compilation or setup failure as behavioral proof.

Assess status-handler TLS negative coverage: wrong truststore, hostname mismatch, client certificate requirements and cached context lifecycle. Existing mock-based tests and one happy-path BATS request do not prove these scenarios; record gaps explicitly.
External plaintext ensemble TLS inheritance and stale ports/store paths on rotation remain unresolved. Mark receipt incomplete even if focused tests pass; do not post a public offer.
